reviews.review: Remnant 1 is way better. This game was a disappointment and lacks replayability. The maps are larger for no good reason as there is not much to see while exploring and it is confusing to navigate. It is easy to miss the doorway that you need to go through to progress the game. The puzzles are unintuitive and annoying to do. At least the gunplay is still enjoyable and the graphics are pretty. The bosses were doable while the classes available were helpful, especially when having a dog companion. I found the plot okay while the script was mediocre. The DLCs were fine except The Dark Horizon one was confusing to navigate. Only the host needs the DLCs to make it available for co-op, but without the DLCs then you wouldn't be able to access its weapons and equipement. My friend crashed a few times even on potato settings. Overall, if you really want to play this game (preferably with friends) then get it with a big discount, but you're not missing much if you skip this game.
Great graphics and story and fighting mechanics.

Definitely a fresh take on the souls genre with a lot positives but the game falls short from being a good game and that it becomes much worse especially towards the end.

Combat stays very unidimensional. You are trying to get a higher dps by upgrading your weapons but the cost of upgrades make it not worth it to explore different weapons if you respect your time and want to play only once playthrough. Too many worthless rings.

I like the procedural aspect of the game and the idea of having a different experience than others. The worlds for me are not equally interesting. I enjoyed the fae one and spent time to do most of the additional dungeons.

Bosses were ok. Some better than others with one exception: the final boss!
That is one of the worst boss designs that I have ever experienced. There are sound queues but they are not differentiated enough to know how quick you need to react and this is a huge problem because of how fast the attacks are. Every action you make is a slow commitment and getting hit once basically ruins the attempt. The animation to get up is so slow that it's guaranteed you will get hit immediately after or when you are trying to heal. The ammo drops are a hell to gather. The second phase effects are just a mess especially in an arena where you have no cover and you fall off the map. No idea how they decided that it was worth shipping that way.

Get this game if you are willing to experience something new. Probably worth more if you plan on playing co-op (I didn't). You'll have some fun but don't expect a great game.
